name: Seespitz Achenkirch
kurzbeschreibung: Seespitz Achenkirch on Lake Achensee's northern shore features a sandy bathing lido, shallow swim lagoon, ferry landings, and scenic vistas of Rofan and Karwendel.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The idyllic leisure and aquatic paradise of Seespitz Achenkirch rests at an elevation of 929 metres along the sunlit northern shoreline of Lake Achensee within the municipality of Achenkirch. Flanked by the precipitous limestone amphitheatre of the Karwendel Alps to the west and the crags of the Rofan range to the east, the delta of the Achenkirch brook creates a stunning recreational haven on Tirol's largest lake. Thanks to sheltered shallow sandbars, the sparkling alpine waters warm considerably faster here than in the deep fjord basin, reaching refreshing summer temperatures between 19 and 22 degrees Celsius. The modern Achenkirch lakeside lido delights holidaymakers with manicured sunbathing lawns, leafy shade trees, timber sunning piers, and beach volleyball courts. The site also accommodates a prime landing jetty for the heritage Achensee boat line, cruising between Pertisau and Maurach since 1887. Consistent thermal valley breezes create supreme conditions for kiteboarders and sailors.

Route & Anforderungen

Departing from Seespitz, visitors can undertake gentle walks or demanding alpine ascents. The flat, barrier-free lakeside promenade traces the water's edge to the Scholastika pier (approx. two kilometres, 30 minutes one way with zero gradient). Seasoned mountain walkers can embark from here onto the adventurous shoreline rock path carved into sheer cliffs leading to the historic Gaisalm—the only alpine pasture accessible solely on foot or via passenger steamer (approx. 2.5 hours, sure-footedness and sturdy hiking footwear essential). The northern promenade is paved and completely stroller-friendly.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via the federal Achensee highway B181 ascending from Jenbach in the Inn Valley or descending from Bavaria across the scenic Achen Pass. Extensive pay parking is situated directly at the beach lido. Rail passengers alight at Jenbach ÖBB station and board regular VVT regional bus line 4080 directly to Achenkirch.

Tipps

Pair an afternoon at the lido with a scenic cruise aboard the Achensee passenger ship to the roadless Gaisalm mountain tavern. Savor fresh alpine lake char on the waterside terrace before catching the ferry back.
preis: Promenades freely accessible; beach lido admission approx. €5-7; lake ferry fares by timetable
oeffnungszeiten: Lakeshore paths open year-round; bathing establishment and ferry fleet operate May to October
